Verdict: inconclusive.

Positive: Running ./mvnw -DskipTests verify on orci-utils executed both spotbugs:check and pmd:check and passed clean with zero findings.
Negative: With a new High finding present, the same build passed when run with the -Dspotbugs.skip and -Dpmd.skip flags that the gating and release jobs use.
Red check: An injected null dereference failed the build on NP_ALWAYS_NULL and an injected unused local failed it on PMD UnusedLocalVariable, both reverted.

Automation: No application-level test applies; the CI static-analysis job is the enforcement and should be confirmed green on main.

This ticket has no runtime surface, so it could not be validated against the running app and needs a CI run to confirm the baselines hold across all modules.
